plan: Validate locale/use, translate each translatable field while collecting fallback diagnostics, and format names, dates, dimensions, and quotations with explicit locale rules.
Assemble ordered fields, prune rightmost optional paragraphs for mobile budgets, and expand symbols plus image descriptions for audio output.
Return deterministic text with sorted omission and fallback lists without mutating the input or using process locale state.

trace.source_relation: Locale-specific name order, dates, dimensions, and quotation punctuation
trace.target_mechanism: Explicit locale tables and pure formatting helpers independent of process locale state

trace.source_relation: Missing translations fall back to source text and must be reported
trace.target_mechanism: Per-string translation closure with a deduplicating fallback set returned in sorted order

trace.source_relation: Mobile repeatedly omits optional paragraphs from the end while retaining mandatory fields and credits
trace.target_mechanism: Right-to-left optional-paragraph removal with full ordered-label length checks

trace.source_relation: Accessible audio includes image descriptions and verbalizes &, ×, and %
trace.target_mechanism: Audio-only image-description assembly and locale-specific symbol expansion

trace.source_relation: Output must be deterministic and input must not be mutated
trace.target_mechanism: Fresh intermediate collections and sorted diagnostic lists
